description: Async request to query a SearchIndex entity's OpenSearch index. Identifies the target index and carries the search-request body.

searchIndexId.description: The ID of the SearchIndex entity to query.

searchQuery.description: The OpenSearch _search request body. See SearchQuery for the allowlisted top-level keys, defaults, and per-request limits.

responseParts.description: Optional list of additional parts to include in the SearchQueryResults beyond the default HITS + offset. Null or empty means HITS only (the default minimal payload). Requesting parts also drives the corresponding work in OpenSearch (aggregations, total-hit tracking).
